Economy · India

Foreign investors withdraw funds from Indian equities

Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) withdrew ₹8,731 crore from Indian equities in a single week, becoming net sellers. Another report indicated a withdrawal of ₹7,443 crore from Indian equities during the same week. These figures highlight a shift in investment sentiment among foreign investors.
